task: Bounded public WeightLoader lifetime fixes for main wrapup
source_of_runtime_fix: 2b0100c (selected shared ownership, stable metadata and diagnostic lock only)
status: Implementation ready; no build, unit test, sanitizer, HTTP or model payload access performed by wrap_io agent.
implementation: EnsureOpen returns a shared_ptr copied while holding the existing LRU mutex. ReadTensor, ReadTensorToDevice and FindTensor retain it until they finish using the shard.

FindTensor copies successful metadata into a loader-owned unordered_map under the same mutex. Values are immutable and never erased, so returned pointers survive LRU eviction and map rehash until loader destruction.
open_shards takes the same mutex and reports cached handles; active readers may retain additional evicted shards.
Main API signatures, file format, loading policy and H2D enqueue behavior are unchanged.

contracts.weight_loader_metadata_survives_eviction: Retain a tensor pointer, visit 31 other shards at cache capacity one, then verify original complete metadata and identical pointer on lookup.
contracts.weight_loader_read_survives_eviction: Pause actual pread before reading bytes; a concurrent second-shard read must finish while blocked; evicted descriptor must stay open until first read returns and then close exactly once; both byte sequences must match.
contracts.weight_loader_device_read_survives_evict: Same deterministic pread eviction through existing ReadTensorToDevice API, plus host H2D double verifies bytes, source/destination, kind and stream forwarding.
contracts.weight_loader_device_enqueue_survives_ev: Pause inside host cudaMemcpyAsync double; concurrent shard eviction must not close the original file until enqueue call returns.
contracts.weight_loader_missing_tensor_and_shard: Missing index name, missing tensor in a valid shard, and missing shard fail both reads and metadata lookup without copying or touching destination buffers; valid read still succeeds afterward.
contracts.weight_loader_concurrent_small_cache: Eight readers start at a barrier and read/check 32 shards across 1024 accesses at cache capacity one while the main thread queries open_shards; metadata, byte content and cache bound are checked.

fixture_policy: Synthetic files are created only inside CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR/fixtures using unique mkdtemp directories and removed by RAII; configure binary directory under source/build or wrapup evidence root.
dependencies: CUDA headers only; no CUDA runtime library/device or model files

suggested_commands_from_source.negative_control: In a separate evidence-root copy of this IO-only target, replace only weight_loader.h/.cpp with 8ea85b1 versions. Run selected lifetime tests in separate processes under ASan so an expected use-after-free does not prevent recording other cases. Do not overwrite the integrated source.

coverage_limits: The cudaMemcpyAsync test double copies host bytes synchronously. It proves host call/lifetime and argument forwarding only, not real GPU transfer, caller staging-buffer lifetime after enqueue or stream completion.

A clean stress result is not a proof of all thread interleavings; deterministic blocking covers actual read/eviction overlap, while optional TSan separately targets unsynchronized metadata/cache diagnostics.
Metadata storage grows with successfully queried distinct tensor names and remains until loader destruction. It retains metadata, not shard payloads.
WeightIndex must outlive WeightLoader; callers must join outstanding operations before destroying the loader. Those existing caller lifetime obligations are now documented.
This change does not establish HTTP quality, performance, model correctness or release acceptance.
